metadata.description: A real OpenCode 2.0.18 session recorded at the HTTP and SSE boundary: a foreground subagent launches its own background subagent and returns at once, so the thread's turn ends while that grandchild still runs. When the grandchild ends, OpenCode reports it to the foreground subagent's session and wakes that session to answer the report. Nesting needs experimental.subagent_depth 2. T3's per-turn instructions entry (answered 204, as 2.0.18 does) is written before the thread's first turn.
